key_expressions: What do you do in your free time?,
Do you want to try it together?,

A: Do you have any hobbies?
Wow, that sounds more active than I expected.
Do you go out every weekend to do it?
B: Yeah, I really like hiking!
It’s tiring sometimes, but it’s fun.
I try to go whenever I have time on weekends.

A: I’m trying to find a new hobby these days.
Piano was harder than I thought because my hands didn’t follow well.
But I think it would be fun if I learn it.
B: Oh, so you like music!
Everyone struggles at first. Your hands get used to it.
Yeah, once you start playing little by little, you’ll improve fast.

A: What do you usually do in your free time?
Oh, I also like filming videos sometimes.
Editing is harder than it looks, right?
B: I’m into making vlogs lately.
Nice! Then we must have a lot to talk about.
Yeah, it takes a long time and you need to focus.

A: Do you like reading?
I really enjoy reading novels too.
Do you have any recommendations?
B: Yeah! I especially like mystery novels.
Oh, I love that kind of vibe too!
I can recommend a book I read recently.

A: Do you work out often?
I feel like my stamina is getting worse lately.
Is that exercise difficult to start?
B: Yeah, I do yoga pretty often.
Yeah, you need to keep at it to get stronger.
It’s a bit tough at first, but it gets easier.

A: What are you into these days?
Taking photos feels really charming to me.
But camera settings are a bit difficult, right?
B: I’m really into photography lately.
Right? Capturing a moment is really fun.
Yeah, it seems complicated at first but you get used to it.

A: Do you like playing games?
My friends said that game is super fun.
Let’s play together sometime!
B: Yeah, I play games pretty often.
I know, time flies when you start playing!
Sure, it’s even more fun with friends.

A: Do you cook as a hobby?
Wow, food must taste even better when you make it yourself!
Can you recommend an easy dish to try?
B: Yeah, I cook at home a lot these days.
Yeah, it feels rewarding too!
Pasta is easy. You can make it quickly.

A: What would you like to learn as a hobby?
Oh, dancing needs good rhythm, so it’s pretty hard.
But it must be really fun once you get used to it!
B: I want to learn dancing.
I’ve been looking for music to practice with.
Yeah, once your body relaxes, it gets much more fun.

A: What would you like to do when you have free time?
Oh, I love traveling too!
That place sounds really charming.
B: I want to go traveling.
Going to a new place makes me feel great!
Yeah, the scenery is beautiful and the food is good too.
